scientific_limitations: Unit-edge metric on the specific thirteen-vertex Paley graph flag triangulation, not the geometric flat-torus length spectrum or a universal flag-torus theorem.
The infinite marked formula concerns closed edge walks; only the minimum nonzero layer is classified among simple cycles.
Generic hexagonal-cover and torus length-spectrum methods are known; novelty is asserted for this exact three-direction systolic shell, complete carrier census, affine orbit and instance formula.
A logically equivalent 13-vertex census in older lattice/map terminology could remain unlocated.
